item.title: New TLR 22X-4 2.0 1/10th 4wd Buggy Kits [VIDEO]
item.description: Introducing the all new TLR 22X-4 2.0 Race Kit, built from the lessons of the revolutionary 22 series and engineered for the next era of electric racing dominance on today’s high grip tracks.

item.title: Team Xray XB8e'26 1/8th E-Buggy Presentation
item.description: Team Xray has released the full presentation for the 2026 XB8e 1/8th Electric Buggy platform.

item.title: New Team GFRP Teflon Coated Small Bore Shock Bodies
item.description: Team GFRP has released new all black teflon coated small bore shock bodies as well as a new anti-wear grease and a 5.5mm thumb wrench.

item.title: New ProTek RC 1S and 2S Stock Spec LiPos
item.description: ProTek RC is pleased to announce the release of two more batteries to its very popular new “Stock Spec” brand line.

item.title: New Avid RC -2 22X C-Block
item.description: The Avid TLR 22X -2° C Pivot Block was first innovated by Avid for the B6.3 and has turned into a must-have if you are racing on high bite surfaces such as carpet or turf.

item.title: New EcoPower 2S SCX30 LiPo
item.description: EcoPower is pleased to announce the release of its new ECP-4018 2S battery for the Axial SCX30 and other 1/24th scale RC vehicles.

item.title: New RC Discharger Branded Heat Shrink
item.description: Upgrade your wiring with the official RC Discharger Heat Shrink.

item.title: Understanding Team Associated 1/8th Diff Gear Options With Brandon Rose [VIDEO]
item.description: In his latest video, Brandon Rose covers the Team Associated 1/8th Scale Diff-Gear options and reasons why you may want to run the different gears.

item.title: New JConcepts T7 and SC7 Chassis Protectors
item.description: JConcepts has continued its tradition of making tape since 2008 with the newest releases of the RC10T7 and RC10SC7 chassis protective sheet.

item.title: Orlowski Wins 2026 TITC
item.description: Michał Orłowski was crowned the 2026 TITC champion this past weekend at RC Addict for the 21st running of the prestigious event.
